name: room-booking-webapp

dependencies.name: room-booking-api
dependencies.description: Loads rooms, searches free rooms, reads busy times, and creates, lists and cancels the Member's bookings.

description: The single browser surface for Members: browse and search rooms, see a room's busy times, book a room, and list and cancel one's own bookings. A separate deployable only because it is the user-facing SPA; it holds no data of its own and calls room-booking-api.
